step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an application stack template packaged into Service Catalog products to streamline devops deployments across environments. On the left, an application stack containing CloudFront, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, Certificate Manager (ACM), and Route 53 is encapsulated. A bracket links these components into AWS Service Catalog products (Product A, Product B, Product C). These standardized Service Catalog products are assembled via AWS CloudFormation templates, which are then passed into AWS CodePipeline for deployment across Dev, Test, and Prod environments.
